and observed a 25% reduction in energy costs.

one_line: The paper applies a fuzzy DEMATEL method with an expert panel to analyse interdependencies among challenges Brazilian companies face in adopting Energy Management Systems (ISO 50001); it is a general decision-analysis study not tied to any continuous-flow production facility, with cement and naphtha-reforming references appearing only as cited literature.
